s.note: the Paris trip that goes wrong
s.how: Melt 30g butter, stir in 2 tbsp flour, whisk in 300ml milk and cook until thick. Spread 8 slices white bread with Dijon and béchamel, fill with 150g ham and half of 150g gruyère, close and top with the rest of the sauce and cheese. Bake at 200C until bubbling.

s.note: the Albanian gang he hunts down
s.how: Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g feta, 200g ricotta and 2 eggs. Brush 8 sheets filo with 80g melted butter, spread filling along each, roll into ropes and coil in a round tin. Bake at 190C for 35 minutes and cut into wedges.

m.note: the tense family dinner with his old colleague
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Push 60g tarragon butter under the skin of a 1.8kg chicken and roast at 220C then 180C. Make a pan sauce with 150ml white wine. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.how: Melt 150g sugar to amber caramel and pour into 4 ramekins. Whisk 4 eggs, 2 yolks, 100g sugar, 500ml milk and the seeds of a vanilla bean. Pour over and bake in a water bath at 150C for 40 minutes. Chill overnight and turn out.

d.note: a glass in Paris before the hunt
d.how: Open a 750ml bottle of Bordeaux red an hour before dinner and let it breathe. Pour about 150ml into each of four big glasses, swirl, and keep the bottle on the table for top-ups.
